name: Exec Cluster Cost: Flat Fee — $1/Trade Commission + Fixed Slippage
description: Tests: FlatFee commission ($1/trade) + Fixed slippage ($0.01). Run with --cost flat_fee
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER COST: Flat Fee Commission
# Run with: --cost flat_fee --cash 100000
# Validates: flat dollar-per-trade commission, fixed dollar slippage
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: RSI oversold ===
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)
entry = rsi_val < 30
exit = rsi_val > 70
held = hold_until(entry, exit)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Risk-based sizing with bundled 2:1 R:R
atr_val = atr(src.h, src.l, src.c, 14)
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price, rr_ratio=2.0)(risk_pct=1.5, stop_distance=atr_val * 2)
